svg.title: AQcredix
svg.desc: The AQcredix mark: a light track ring, the brand-blue arc that rides it, and the A. No background tile, so the mark sits on whatever the tab, the search result or the home screen puts behind it. On the site the arc rotates (hero-logo-arc, lens-rotate.js); a favicon cannot animate, so it is drawn in its rest position. Colours are literals, not CSS custom properties, because this file is loaded as an image where the site stylesheet does not apply. 4C6FFF is the accent; D8E0E6 is the track.
